verdict.rationale: Supabase Storage explicitly documents on-the-fly image resizing/optimization with transform options on public/signed URLs and client-library support, directly enabling image transformation without a custom pipeline (supabase-docs-42, supabase-supp-image-transformations). Minor caveat is that this feature is gated to Pro plan and above. missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation/benchmark of transform quality or performance beyond vendor docs.
